name: Boardbite
summary:
Boardbite is a free collection of board and card games played in the web browser, with no download or install. Both games are for 2 to 6 players, and can be played online with friends at a shared table, on one screen, or against bots.

Dice & Deeds is a property-trading board game: roll the dice, buy cities, collect whole countries and build hotels until one tycoon is left. Last Bite is a fast card game: match the flavor or the number, block, flip and feed other players extra cards, and be the first with an empty hand.
